item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day's got structure built in — check-ins, a moment to ask if what you're doing supports the life you want, and a prompt to catch yourself projecting or mind-reading. That's the real work: noticing the story you're telling yourself before it runs the show. Mindset isn't one big shift, it's catching small moments and choosing again. Action: before you react to anything today, pause and ask what's actually true versus what you're assuming.
